issues: asset_note: Three bracket detail subfigures labeled (a), (b), (c). (a) cantilevered member from a single vessel clip; (b) knee-braced bracket fixed to shell; (c) bracket with one member affixed to shell and the other bearing/sliding on a shell reinforcing pad. Annotations visible: 'May be bolted to allow slight amount of articulation' near (b), and 'Not welded, bearing contact of angle on pad' near (c).
